needed.evidence: No continuous sidewalk; the edge of the carriageway meets a grass verge and a building setback, so pedestrians would have to walk in the road.
needed.suggestion: Construct a continuous paved footway along the left side, set back from the carriageway edge, to give pedestrians a safe place to walk.

needed.evidence: No sidewalk on the right; the road edge is an unpaved shoulder and grass, with no defined pedestrian path.
needed.suggestion: Provide a paved footway on the right side, separated from the carriageway, so pedestrians do not have to use the road.

needed.evidence: Pedestrians are seen walking in the carriageway near a junction and buildings on both sides, but there is no marked or signalised crossing.
needed.suggestion: Install a marked pedestrian crossing with dropped kerbs at this junction to give a safe, visible place to cross.

needed.suggestion: Add dropped kerbs at the new crossing location to allow step-free access for pedestrians.
